hero.title: Jonas Messias
hero.description: I architect and build complete products — from front-ends in React and Next.js to back-ends in Node.js, NestJS, Java (Spring) and Laravel, with microservices, queues, databases and cloud infrastructure.

about.title: About
about.lead: I'm a full-stack software engineer — not just a front-end dev.
paragraphs: I work across every layer of the product: interfaces in React, Next.js and Angular; APIs and services in Node.js (Fastify, Express, NestJS), Java (Spring Boot) and PHP (Laravel); and the architecture that holds it together — microfrontends with Module Federation, Clean Architecture and modular monoliths.

I also own the infrastructure: AWS, Docker, messaging with Kafka and RabbitMQ, caching with Redis, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB databases. I care about systems that scale, with real automated testing and observability.

technologies.title: Tech stack
technologies.description: The tools I use to take a product from design to production — across every layer.

projects.title: Featured work
projects.description: One real production system as the headline case, followed by projects exploring architecture and product.

osm.title: oSeuMáximo
osm.tagline: An education SaaS ecosystem, in production
osm.overview: I architected and built a complete multi-app system in production: a central back-end serving three front-ends, with multi-tenant SSO across several brands, billing, queues and end-to-end test coverage.

platform.desc: NestJS + Fastify core with Clean Architecture: PostgreSQL + Redis, Prisma, JWT auth (jose) + Argon2, multi-tenant SSO, billing and queues (BullMQ). 56 suites / 691 tests, structured logging, Sentry and Swagger.

app.desc: Study app at oseumaximo.com: React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Zustand and Stripe.js checkout.

admin.desc: Internal admin panel with role-based access control (ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN): React 19, Vite 6, Tailwind v4, TanStack Query and Zustand.

prof.desc: Live-class scheduler at oseuprof.com: React 19, Vite, shadcn/ui, framer-motion, Zod + react-hook-form, Vitest + Cypress.
